newsitem.title: POLAND: Polisa wants to withdraw shares from OTC.
newsitem.headline: Polisa wants to withdraw shares from OTC.

text.p: Poland's insurer Polisa, which has some shares listed on the Warsaw bourse and some on the OTC market, will apply to the bourse to accept the OTC shares for trade on the exchange, the Parkiet daily said on Friday.

Parkiet quoted the firm's deputy president Zygfryd Kielarski as saying that late in January or early in February Polisa would apply to the bourse to list its 4.3 million shares currently traded on the Polish Centralna Tabela Ofert (CTO).

Polisa entered the OTC market in mid-December because it wanted its shareholders to get tax breaks on capital gains granted on shares which were publicly floated but acquired before the firm became public.
Nobody in the firm was available for comment.
Polisa currently has 4.1 million shares traded on the main market of the Warsaw bourse.
